Woman gets back at ex by sparking cat donation campaign | The Moment

The president of SOS Prairie Rescue, Ashlyn Weninger, tells The National about the moment the group received an anonymous message that started a matching campaign encouraging people who went through a bad breakup to donate, called Spite for Strays.
